name: Mahanadi Coalfields
bear: Volumes and earnings are flat-to-down: FY26 production -3.0% (218.31 MT vs 225.17 MT), revenue -2.6%, PAT -1.2%; Q1FY27 PAT -2%.
Pure OFS — no growth capital to MCL; the parent is monetising a cash cow while retaining 90% and control.
Notified (FSA) coal prices are administratively set and last raised in 2023; realisations depend on e-auction premiums, which are volatile (41% Jul-26 vs 59% Aug-26).
Evacuation and land/R&R constraints in Angul/Talcher, plus Odisha rail congestion, have repeatedly capped despatch below production.
BCCL trades ~25% below its debut price despite the hype, showing post-listing derating risk for PSU coal spin-offs.
bull: Largest, most profitable CIL arm: FY26 PAT Rs 10,698 cr on Rs 30,550 cr revenue (~35% net margin), ~28% of CIL output and ~30% of CIL consolidated profit.
Low-cost, almost entirely opencast Talcher/Ib Valley operations with ~70 surface miners; 9,840 MT audited reserves (~45 years) and 106.76 BT resources.
Growth pipeline (Subhadra 25 MTPA, Balabhadra 10 MTPA; 300 MT FY30 goal) makes MCL the key engine for CIL's 1 BT ambition.
High cash generation and payout (Rs 8,600 cr dividend FY25) supports a high dividend yield post-listing; RoNW ~60%.
Strong precedent demand for CIL subsidiary IPOs (BCCL 107-147x subscribed, +96% listing) and likely Coal India-shareholder quota improve allotment odds.
business: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd (Sambalpur, Odisha; carved out of SECL on 3 Apr 1992; Miniratna Cat-I since 2019) is Coal India's largest and most profitable subsidiary. It mines non-coking thermal coal from the Talcher and Ib Valley coalfields via 17 mines (14 opencast, 3 underground) as of 30 Jun 2026, using ~70 surface miners with coal handling plants, silos, rapid loading systems and one washery. FY26 output 218.31 MT = 28.3-28.4% of CIL production and ~21-22.4% of India's non-coking coal. Audited reserves 9,840.31 MT (1 Apr 2026; ~45-year life at current rates), total resources 106.76 BT. Customers are predominantly power utilities (FSA-linked, incl. NTPC Talcher/Kaniha and state gencos), plus steel/cement; balance sold via e-auction at premiums to notified price. Growth projects: Subhadra OCP (25 MTPA) and Balabhadra (10 MTPA); FY30 aspiration 300 MT; sanctioned project outlay ~Rs 41,120 cr (51 projects); Rs 11,782 cr earmarked for coal-gasification.

financials.note: Revenue from operations Rs 30,549.6 cr (-2.6% YoY); PAT Rs 10,698 cr per CIL CMD/BS (Reuters reported Rs 10,678 cr, -1.3%). Net worth FY26 not disclosed in coverage.
Gross coal sales Rs 36,606 cr; revenue from operations implied ~Rs 31,360 cr from FY26 -2.6% YoY. Dividend paid Rs 8,600 cr. RoNW = PAT/closing net worth.

Gross coal sales Rs 37,200 cr; Wikipedia lists FY24 revenue Rs 31,076.88 cr / PAT Rs 10,176.35 cr which conflicts with Tradebrains' Rs 11,845 cr PAT — treat FY24 PAT as unverified. RoNW computed on closing net worth.

flags: Governance: PSU with President of India/CIL as promoters; government-directed pricing, dividend and supply (FSA) obligations override minority interests.
Dividend dependence: CIL relies on MCL for ~30% of profit and large dividends; payout policy set by parent/DIPAM, not by MCL's board independently.
Government pricing: notified prices for FSA coal set by CIL/MoC; minimal pricing power on ~80%+ of volumes.
E-auction sensitivity: a large share of incremental profit comes from e-auction premia tied to global thermal coal prices and power-demand cycles.
Shareholder-quota clause not yet verified in the DRHP; confirm in RHP before positioning in COALINDIA for eligibility.
FY24 financials in secondary sources conflict (PAT Rs 11,845 cr vs Rs 10,176 cr) — verify against the DRHP restated financials.

issue.allocation: QIB up to 50% / NII up to 15% / Retail up to 35% of net offer (book-built).
issue.employeeQuota: Not disclosed in press coverage; BCCL precedent was 5% of offer (2.32 cr shares) at Rs 1 discount.
issue.leadManagers: SBI Capital Markets, Axis Capital, BOB Capital Markets, IDBI Capital Markets & Securities, IIFL Capital Services; Registrar: KFin Technologies; listing on BSE and NSE.
issue.objects: 100% offer for sale by Coal India Ltd; no fresh issue, nil proceeds to MCL. Listing benefits only; all proceeds (net of expenses) to the selling shareholder. Face value Rs 2. Pre-offer promoter holding 100% (President of India via MoC + Coal India); post-issue ~90% CIL.
issue.shareholderQuota: Not confirmed from public DRHP coverage as of 4 Sep 2026. Precedent: BCCL (Jan 2026) and CMPDI (Mar 2026) each reserved 10% of the issue for Coal India shareholders holding >=1 CIL share on the record date; IPO Central headlines MCL as a 'Shareholder Quota IPO'. Treat as likely but unverified until RHP.

logistics: If the RHP includes a Coal India shareholder reservation (as in BCCL/CMPDI, 10% of issue), holding as little as 1 COALINDIA share in demat on the RHP record date qualifies for the shareholder category (application in addition to retail bid allowed). Market lot for COALINDIA is 1 share (~Rs 418). Record date is fixed at RHP filing (CMPDI: record date 12 Mar 2026 for a 20 Mar open). No record date announced for MCL yet.

street.view: MCL and SECL IPOs to be completed within FY27 ('by the year-end positively'); timing subject to market conditions and government directives.
Buy on Coal India, TP Rs 550, citing rising offtake and declining stockpiles; MCL listing seen as value unlock.
Positive on Coal India: strong power demand and three-year-low coal inventories support e-auction premia.
Flags MCL as a shareholder-quota IPO and 'Coal India's most profitable subsidiary'; ~Rs 10,000 cr issue expected.
MCL FY26 PAT Rs 10,678 cr (-1.3%), revenue Rs 30,550 cr (-2.6%); notes BCCL ~25% below debut while CMPDI +39% since March listing.

timeline.expectedWindow: Launch targeted within FY2026-27 (by 31 Mar 2027); CIL CMD B. Sairam (31 Aug 2026): 'We plan to complete the IPO by the year-end positively... exact month and date will depend upon the market conditions and the government directives'. SEBI observations typically 2-3 months after DRHP (BCCL: DRHP Jun 2025 -> nod 19 Sep 2025 -> issue Jan 2026), implying a Nov-Dec 2026 SEBI window and a Dec 2026-Feb 2027 launch window.

valuation.impliedMcapNote: Press (Tradebrains/ConstructionWorld, 27-29 Jul 2026; IPO Central) sizes the 10% OFS at ~Rs 10,000 cr, implying ~Rs 1,00,000 cr equity value. No price band yet; DRHP carries no valuation.
valuation.impliedPENote: Rs 1,00,000 cr / FY26 PAT Rs 10,698 cr = 9.3x; at 8.3x (Coal India TTM P/E) the 10% stake would fetch ~Rs 8,900 cr.
